correctness.rationale: The six difference steps give the specified (16,6,2,2) Shrikhande graph and 808 nonempty open-neighborhood faces. Independent reconstruction gives (16,120,320,240,96,16). The 375-pair vertex Morse matching was checked on all 2736 directed cover incidences and has exactly one critical 0-cell, one 1-cell and 56 2-cells. Exact independent signed Morse recursion yields attaching-degree distribution (-2:4, 0:39, +2:13), with gcd 2; therefore the one-circle/56-disk CW model is RP^2 wedge 55 S^2. The source offers an alternative 256-step elementary collapse plus 104 generator-disk cancellations. Finite computations are exhaustive for the named finite graph, not general graphs.
